39/S0.subgoal: Explain the broad categories of interaction techniques in immersive environments.

39/S1.subgoal: Explain the parameters and types of object selection techniques.

39/S2.subgoal: Describe hand selection techniques, including go-go, prism, and intent-driven selection.

39/S3.subgoal: Describe pointing-based selection techniques like ray casting, bend cast, and depth ray.

39/S4.subgoal: Explain image plane and volumetric selection techniques.

39/S5.subgoal: Explain the general concept of object manipulation and hand manipulation techniques.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe indirect manipulation techniques like 3D widgets, proxies, and world in miniature.

39/S7.subgoal: Explain bimanual manipulation techniques including spindle and spindle plus wheel.

39/S8.subgoal: Describe integrated hybrid manipulation techniques, specifically the HOMER technique.
